title: Hóa học khí quyển
meaning: Thành phần khí quyển, phản ứng quang hóa, ozone, aerosol và biến đổi hóa học của trace gases.
ownership: C10 chemical composition/reactions; B1.4 Earth-system reservoirs/flows and X01 climate synthesis boundary-only.

title: Hóa học nước và đất
meaning: Acid-base, redox, speciation, sorption và transport chemistry trong nước/đất.
ownership: C10 chemical transformations; B1.4 hydrology/geology boundary-only.

title: Ô nhiễm và độc chất
meaning: Nguồn, fate, dose/exposure và chemical hazard của pollutants với phân biệt hazard-risk.
ownership: C10 pollutant chemistry; X03 health synthesis boundary-only.

title: Quy trình công nghiệp
meaning: Mass/energy/reaction/separation logic của chemical processes, yield/selectivity, safety and waste.

title: Xúc tác
meaning: Catalyst activity, selectivity, stability, heterogeneous/homogeneous concepts and process relevance.
ownership: C10 industrial/environmental catalysis; C04/C07 retain general kinetics/physical chemistry foundations.

title: Hóa học xanh
meaning: Thiết kế hóa học giảm hazard, waste, energy/material intensity và tăng circularity where chemically meaningful.
ownership: C10 green chemistry; policy/economic synthesis boundary-only.

title: Kinh tế nguyên tử
meaning: Atom economy measures incorporation of reactant atoms into desired product and differs from yield or full environmental impact.

title: Vòng đời vật liệu
meaning: Chemical/material flows from extraction and production through use, recovery, recycling and end-of-life with system-boundary discipline.
ownership: C10 chemistry/material lifecycle; X01/X03/X04 and future Earth/information scopes boundary-only.
